setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=new RegExp("N[\u00e3a]o foi poss[i\u00ed]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|indispon[i\u00ed]vel|Algo deu errado|Something went wrong|Falha ao|Pop-up bloqueado|Popup bloqueado|Sem permiss[\u00e3a]o",'i');const ign=new RegExp("$^",'i');const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&!ign.test(m[0])&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);return 1})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}const se=document.scrollingElement;return se&&se.scrollHeight>se.clientHeight+4?se:null};const el=[...document.querySelectorAll("main *")].filter(e=>e.offsetParent!==null&&e.textContent.trim().startsWith("Distribuição por forma de pagamento")).sort((a,b)=>a.textContent.length-b.textContent.length)[0];if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const c=rolagem(el);if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const dy=Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top-300);if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const y0=c.scrollTop;await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=()=>{const p=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/700),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0+dy*e;p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const norm=t=>t.replace(/[\s\u00a0]+/g,' ').toLowerCase();const esp=["Distribuição por forma de pagamento", "Dinheiro", "Pix/Transferência", "Saldo"];let out='';for(let i=0;i<20;i++){const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("main")].filter(e=>!false||e.innerText.includes(""));const el=false?els[els.length-1]:els[0];if(!el){out='DIFERENTE: sem elemento';}else{const t=norm(el.innerText);const falta=esp.filter(e=>!t.includes(norm(e)));if(!falta.length)return 'OK: '+esp.join(' | ');out='DIFERENTE: faltou '+JSON.stringify(falta)+' em: '+t.slice(0,260);}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return out})()

steps.js: (async()=>{const rolagem=(el)=>{let c=el&&el.parentElement;while(c&&c!==document.body){const s=getComputedStyle(c);if(/(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+4)return c;c=c.parentElement;}const se=document.scrollingElement;return se&&se.scrollHeight>se.clientHeight+4?se:null};const c=rolagem(document.querySelector("main"+' *'));if(!c)return 'SEM ROLAGEM';const y0=c.scrollTop;if(y0<3)return 'ok';await new Promise(res=>{const t0=performance.now();const f=()=>{const p=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/700),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;c.scrollTop=y0*(1-e);p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return 'topo:'+Math.round(c.scrollTop)})()
